method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 11 of 14 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: VP ≠ VNP
picks.author: Lance Fortnow (noreply@blogger.com)
picks.why_it_matters: A Lean-verified separation of VP from VNP, explained through determinant versus permanent, with what it does and doesn't imply for P vs NP.

picks.title: The rise and fall of the ‘Byzantine’ Empire
picks.author: Peter Frankopan
picks.why_it_matters: Argues 'Byzantine' is a western-European invention and that the eastern Roman state survived a millennium through resilient institutions.

picks.title: Command-line JSON filtering at 20 GB/s
picks.author: Daniel Lemire
picks.why_it_matters: Shows how simdjson-style parsing, parsing only the fields a filter needs, and chunked multithreading make jq filtering 37x to 210x faster.

picks.title: The Future Needs Furniture
picks.author: Venkatesh Rao
picks.why_it_matters: Proposes three kinds of ontological crisis, labels, learning, and care, as a frame for why AI-era unease is about distinctions we can no longer act on.

picks.title: The Influencers’ Influencer
picks.author: Vaughn Tan
picks.why_it_matters: Archival detective story: MFK Fisher's hidden campaign that turned Japanese food into American fine dining, and how upstream tastemakers shape influence.
